caption:
Stock market news | IRDAI committee sparks 8% surge in insurance stocks

On 25 November 2026 the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India set up an expert committee to examine distribution reforms. The regulator received about 2.18 lakh responses to its consultation paper covering 32 questions.

Following the announcement, shares of PB Fintech, HDFC Life and Max Life jumped up to 8%, showing market confidence that the reforms may benefit policyholders, insurers and distributors.
